verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Supabase AI Assistant is integrated into the Dashboard. They state it generates SQL queries from your specifications, analyzes SQL errors and suggests fixes, and gives table-specific feedback and recommendations. It can also generate and deploy Edge Functions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the assistant explaining the backend as a whole (only per-table contextual feedback is documented), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard assistant's quality.
